name: vps-vault-sync-monorepo
description: Real-time bidirectional synchronization between Obsidian and a VPS vault folder

scripts.build: npm run build -w @vps-vault-sync/shared && npm run build -w @vps-vault-sync/server && npm run build -w @vps-vault-sync/obsidian-plugin
scripts.test: npm run test -w @vps-vault-sync/shared && npm run test -w @vps-vault-sync/server
